statement: Intel reported Q2 2026 GAAP gross margin of 40.4%, versus 27.5% in the prior-year quarter, with non-GAAP gross margin of 41.8% versus 29.7%.
why: A near-13-point year-over-year margin gain says Intel is getting paid better for what it ships, consistent with tight supply and stronger mix rather than discounting for volume.

impact.mechanism: Rising gross margin alongside rising revenue indicates pricing power, a demand-side strength signal across the compute supply chain.

evidence.excerpt: GAAP gross margin: 40.4% for Q2 2026, vs 27.5% in the prior-year quarter.

confidence.basis: Primary vendor results release stating both current and prior-year margin.
